column1: # known-stars.tsv — Phase 4 tier-A validation corpus for the v6 binary
# catalogue. Each row is one star system the pipeline must reproduce
# correctly; scripts/catalog/known-stars.test.ts drives per-row
# assertions against public/catalog.bin via the catalog-lookup library.
# wds_id                    WDS positional ID (e.g. "06451-1643"). Empty
#                           for single stars.
# system_name               Display name ("Sirius", "α Cen", "Vega").
# primary_hip               Hipparcos number of the primary. Empty for
#                           HIP-less systems (Tycho-only / no HIP). A row
#                           with neither HIP nor Gaia is looked up by
#                           system_name (Sol — the one record addressable
#                           only by proper name).
# primary_gaia_source_id    Gaia DR3 source_id of the primary (int64).
#                           Empty when no Gaia DR3 match exists (e.g.
#                           Sirius A — saturated in Gaia DR3).
# primary_distance_pc       Expected pipeline distance to the primary
#                           in parsecs.
# primary_distance_pc_err   1-sigma uncertainty on primary_distance_pc.
#                           Used in the tolerance gate (see below).
# primary_absmag            Expected absolute magnitude of the primary —
#                           the INTRINSIC (de-extincted) value the build
#                           writes, not observed mag − 5·log(d/10). The
#                           build subtracts the Sol→star Edenhofer A_V so
#                           the runtime raymarch re-adds it without
#                           double-counting; luminous stars behind
#                           measurable dust (Antares, ν Sco, the LMC
#                           supergiants) therefore sit brighter here than
#                           their reddened apparent photometry implies.
# primary_spectral          Expected MK spectral type as a human-readable
#                           string ("A0V", "M5.5Ve", "DA1.9"). The test
#                           parses it via classifyFromSimbad and asserts
#                           classIdx + lumClass match record.spectClass +
#                           record.lumClass. The binary stores only those
#                           two bytes; subclass round-trips through the
#                           resolver but is not pinned in catalog.bin.
# primary_ci                Optional pin on record.ci — the INTRINSIC
#                           (de-reddened) B−V the build writes. Pins the
#                           pipeline value; the canonical literature B−V
#                           is noted in notes_source where it differs.
# primary_radius_rsun       Optional pin on record.physicalRadius (R☉).
#                           Pins the pipeline value; canonical published
#                           radii noted in notes_source.
# radius_rel_tol            Optional per-row relative tolerance for
#                           primary_radius_rsun (default 0.10).
# companions                Semicolon-separated tuples:
#                             comp_letter:hip:gaia_id:absmag[:max_sep_au]
#                           Empty for single-star rows. Components with
#                           no HIP leave the hip slot empty
#                           hip + gaia_id + absmag are pulled from
#                           data/binaries/multiples.tsv, which is
#                           itself the validation target —
#                           SIMBAD spot-checks the primaries).
#                           Optional max_sep_au pins the companion's
#                           catalog.bin xyz to within that many AU of
#                           the primary's catalog.bin xyz. Used to
#                           regression-guard synth-promoted companions
#                           whose tangent-projected position depends on
#                           the route-detector in companion-promotion
#                           (Algol Ab/Aa2, Polaris Ab, Capella Ab).
# orbital_period_days       Expected pipeline orbital period in days
#                           (companion record .periodDays). Empty when
#                           the system lacks a well-determined orbit or
#                           the pipeline does not propagate one.
# var_type                  Optional GCVS variability pin: "pulsating" /
#                           "eclipsing" / "other" asserts record.varType
#                           against the catalog-pure VAR_TYPE_* enum;
#                           "none" asserts the record carries NO
#                           variability (varType, period, amplitude all
#                           zero). Empty = no varType assertion.
# var_period_days           Optional GCVS published period in days,
#                           UNQUANTISED. The test applies the build's
#                           encoding (round(P × 10) into uint16, 0.1 d
#                           quanta, 6553.5 d clamp) before comparing to
#                           record.periodDays.
# var_amp_mag               Optional GCVS amplitude (max − min, mag),
#                           unquantised. Encoded as round(amp × 20)
#                           into uint8 (0.05 mag quanta, 12.75 clamp)
#                           before comparing to record.amplitudeMag.
# notes_source              Provenance citation. Required on every row.
#                           Format: "SIMBAD <permalink>" /
#                           "ORB6 entry P=…" / "Gaia DR3 ADQL
#                           spot-check 2026-MM-DD" / "Pietrzyński 2019
#                           LMC distance".
# Asserted by known-stars.test.ts:
#   primary_distance_pc       ±0.01 pc OR 1-sigma, whichever is larger
#   primary_absmag            ±0.05
#   primary_spectral          classIdx (record.spectClass) exact match;
#                             lumClass exact match unless the row's
#                             spectral string is bare-class (no Roman).
#   primary_ci                ±0.03 (float32 + Ballesteros round-trip)
#   primary_radius_rsun       ±10% relative, or the row's radius_rel_tol
#   companion absmag          ±0.05
#   companion hip / gaia_id   exact match
#   orbital_period_days       ±5% (only checked when row has a value)
#   var_type                  exact enum match ("none" = all three zero)
#   var_period_days           exact after uint16 0.1 d quantisation
#   var_amp_mag               exact after uint8 0.05 mag quantisation
# Every row carries notes_source — no row added without a traceable
# citation. Distance + absmag verified against AT LEAST TWO independent
# sources where possible (SIMBAD + Gaia DR3 ADQL; ORB6 + van Leeuwen
# HIP2; etc.). Companion rows use multiples.tsv as one source;
# SIMBAD per-oid as the second. Variability pins quote the GCVS 5.1
# published period + max/min magnitudes (the pipeline input is the
# same frozen GCVS snapshot, so these pins are parse + cross-match +
# encode regression guards; AAVSO / SIMBAD otype spot-checks noted in
# notes_source where consulted). The TSV is the contract — the
# vitest exercises every row, every column.
# Tab-separated. Lines beginning with "#" are skipped by the parser.
# Empty cells render as adjacent tabs.
wds_id
column17: notes_source

# Ba/Bb components because Gaia did not separate them) and the YY Gem
# companion (Castor C, Gaia 892348454394856064, no HIP). multiples.tsv
# carries STF1110 AB (P=459.1 yr — the famous Savary 1828 visual orbit),
# CIA 29 Aa,Ab (P=9.21 d) and CIA 29 Ba,Bb (P=2.93 d).

column17: SIMBAD * alf Gem A sp_type=A1.5IV+ carries NO hip/source_id key, so both machine tiers miss; the record classifies via the curated HIP tier (CURATED_SPTYPE_BY_HIP, A1.5IV). Multi-star showcase: STF1110 AB visual orbit P=167686.275 d (459.1 yr, ORB6 historical-first orbit Savary 1828). Companion C is YY Gem (Castor C, M0.5VeFe-2 eclipsing pair, no HIP, Gaia 892348454394856064). This absmag pins the multiples.tsv UPSTREAM value: Gaia fit one 5p source over the sub-arcsec Ca,Cb pair (G=8.296 + BP−RP=1.93 → combined M_V=8.105 via G→V + parallax 66.31 mas), matching YY Gem's two equal M1V stars at 15.1 pc. In catalog.bin that combined light is split evenly across the two rendered components (Ca/Cb → M_V=8.858 each, summing back to 8.105); the split is pinned in companion-promotion.test.ts. HIP2 parallax 64.12 mas → 15.6 pc. AT-HYG bound source 892348694913501952 (Castor B's, G−V=1.3) to A; the magnitude gate rejects it, so A carries no source_id and routes through hip2_long_baseline. AT-HYG magnitude is the Aa+Ab combined light; the dmag joint split leaves Aa at 0.97, matching Castor A's own V=1.93.

column1: # Castor inner spectroscopic orbits: CIA29 emitted Aa,Ab (P=9.21 d) and
# Ba,Bb (P=2.93 d) into multiples.tsv; the eclipsing Ca,Cb (YY Gem,
# P=0.814 d, ORB6 grade-7) rides the synthesized sub-pair path via the
# orb6_component_overrides.tsv mapping. Inner-pair secondaries inherit
# the blend identity (primary's HIP/Gaia) and promote as synthetic
# catalog records (synth-07346+3153-Ab / -Bb / -Cb).

column17: Inner spectroscopic pair CIA29 Aa,Ab (P=9.21 d, ORB6 grade-1). Ab carries the blend identity (primary's HIP/Gaia) in multiples.tsv and promotes as synth-07346+3153-Ab. Orbit assertion via multiples.tsv bestPeriodMatch. Aa,Ab dmag joint split — see the Castor row.

Inner spectroscopic pair CIA29 Ba,Bb (P=2.93 d, ORB6 grade-3). Bb carries the blend identity and promotes as synth-07346+3153-Bb. Orbit assertion via multiples.tsv bestPeriodMatch. Shares Castor A's record; same split.

column1: # Algol (β Per) — eclipsing-binary archetype. Outer pair LAB Aa,Ab (P=680.17 d,
# ORB6 grade-1 with i=83.66°) and inner spectroscopic Aa1,Aa2 (P=2.867 d,
# ORB6 CSI1, the famous eclipsing pair). Ab and Aa2 multiples.tsv rows
# carry no own gaia/hip; the subdivision pipeline mints synth-03082+4057-Ab and
# synth-03082+4057-2 so companion-promotion surfaces them in catalog.bin
# and build-runtime-binaries can address them through the row-index map.

column17: GCVS bet Per: EA/SD P=2.8673043 d, amp V 2.12→3.39 (1.27) — the eclipsing archetype; VAR_TYPE_ECLIPSING also drives the wings flag + pulsation suppression. SIMBAD * bet Per A sp_type=B8V; Gaia-saturated (no source_id), so spectral resolves via resolveSpectralInfo's SIMBAD HIP fallback tier (without it the radius chain inflated Algol to 12.47 R☉; now 3.2). ORB6 LAB outer orbit Aa,Ab P=680.168 d, e=0.227, i=83.66°. Companion Ab promoted via synthetic ID synth-03082+4057-Ab (no own gaia/hip). max_sep_au=5.0 clamps the route-based sep+PA collocation — Ab projects to 2.76 AU from Algol via sep+PA (0.1″ × 27.571 pc); without the clamp it landed ~100 AU off.

Inner spectroscopic / eclipsing pair Aa1,Aa2 (ORB6 CSI1, P=2.867 d, i=98.70°). multiples.tsv emits the secondary cell with comp set to the WDS prefix-truncation shorthand 2 (= Aa2); the promotion mints synth-03082+4057-Aa2 from the canonical comp so the runtime resolves through the same key. Primary spectral B8V via the SIMBAD HIP fallback tier (Gaia-saturated, no source_id). Aa2 absmag 3.300 = class→M_V for its curated K0IV type (component_sptype_overrides; Kolbas et al. 2015 give M_V≈2.9) — pins the spectral-derived branch, NOT the primary's -0.112 twin value. max_sep_au=0.5 guards the collocation fix — Aa2 bakes collocated (0.0″); BinaryOrbitField overlays the ~0.06 AU inner orbit at runtime.

column1: # AR Cassiopeiae — bright multi-star system (HIP 115990 B3V). Catalog.bin
# carries the primary; outer visual components AB / AC / AI / CD / CI /
# FG / Ia,Ib are emitted as Tier-3 (no orbit) pair rows in multiples.tsv
# (exact kept-pair set pinned in system-pair-topology.tsv). Companions
# with own Gaia photometry (C, D, F, G) are pinned below; E and H are
# standalone _E/_H rows with no photometry (not promoted), Ia/Ib carry
# no identifiers. The famous AR Cas Aa,Ab inner eclipsing pair (P=6.066 d,
# EA-type) is synthesized from the Pulkovo MSC orbit (absent from ORB6
# and Gaia NSS) with per-side MSC types B3IV + A6; its GCVS eclipse
# signal is pinned via the var columns.

column17: AR Cas A; Gaia DR3 source 2011150635728091648 resolves with SIMBAD sp_type=B3V → catalog (spectClass=1 B, lumClass=2 V). Build-catalog distance ~203.14 pc (Bailer-Jones override over the binaries pipeline's 204.68 pc HIP2 anchor). GCVS AR Cas: EA P=6.0663335 d, amp V 4.89→5.02 (0.13). Companions per multiples.tsv (all own-Gaia, gaia_photometry absmags): C=HD 221237A A1V, D=HD 221237B, F=TYC 4011-779-1 A0, G=UCAC4 743-089698 B3. G renders as 'HIP 115990 G' (its FG-pair anchor F is the promoted 'HIP 115990 F' record — composeCompanionName strips the intermediate F rather than doubling it to 'HIP 115990 F G'). Pinned by Gaia id here. Anchor dimmed by flux conservation via the MSC-synthesized Aa,Ab pair mags (5.02/7.42); the previous -1.756 predates the Ab split.

column1: # ν Scorpii (Jabbah) — multiple-star system with high-eccentricity inner
# orbit. Outer ORB6 Aa,Ab pair (P=3674.78 d ≈ 10.06 yr, e=0.92, i=89.7°,
# CHARA-resolved). Visual components B, C, D carry own Gaia IDs and are
# pinned as companions (kept-pair set in system-pair-topology.tsv).
# Inner Aa1,Aa2 spectroscopic sub-pair (SB9_889, P=5.5521 d) subdivided
# from the Pulkovo MSC orbit (absent from ORB6 and Gaia NSS).

column17: ν Sco Aa; SIMBAD * nu Sco A sp_type cell empty for Gaia DR3 source 6245697981070158080, so build-catalog falls through to Gaia GSP-Spec spectraltype_esphs=O (bare class; lumClass=255 unknown). Published SIMBAD literature sp_type elsewhere is B2IV. ORB6 outer Aa,Ab orbit P=3674.78 d, e=0.92, i=89.7° (grade-3 CHARA visual, the highest-eccentricity rendered orbit — Kepler-solver stress case). Companions per multiples.tsv gaia_photometry: B (SIMBAD * nu. Sco B, sp_type empty), C = * nu.02 Sco A B8V, D = * nu.02 Sco B B9V. Inner Aa1,Aa2 (SB9_889, P=5.5521 d — the 1.41 d figure earlier notes carried is not in SB9/MSC) rendered via the Pulkovo MSC orbit. Anchor dimmed twice (flux conservation): by its dmag-split synth companion Ab, and by promoted B's own gaia_photometry flux (M_V -0.29; AT-HYG's mag is the A+B blend) — the residual -1.636 matches A-alone V≈4.35 at 141.9 pc. System distance coherence anchors the root on the clean-Gaia nu-02 members at 136.9 pc; Aa (saturated, hosts the Aa,Ab subsystem) snaps within combined parallax noise.

column1: # ξ Ursae Majoris (Alula Australis, STF1523 AB) — AT-HYG carries the
# system HD-only (no HIP, no Gaia); the record's identifiers come from
# the multiples.tsv HD-keyed backfill (backfillPrimaryIdentifiers), so
# this row is the end-to-end pin on that pass, plus on the sp_type
# refresh reaching backfilled identifiers (the pull unions the WDS-xids
# oids, so the record classifies F8.5:V by its Gaia source key).

column17: SIMBAD * ksi UMa F8.5:V; AT-HYG GJ-anchored 10.42 pc, athyg_position astrometry route. HIP 55203 via ORB6, Gaia 756853643638639104 via SIMBAD xids, both surfaced onto the catalog record by the HD 98231 backfill. ORB6 grade-1 visual orbit AB P=59.89 yr = 21874.93 d.

column1: # ---- Promoted companions (newly minted catalog records) ----------------
# These rows pin companions promoted into catalog.bin by the build's
# read-multiples-and-promote pass. Their primary is already an AT-HYG
# row; the companion is a new record addressable by its OWN identifiers
# (Gaia source_id; HIP may collide with the primary). Each row names the
# absmag imputation branch it pins (primary + WDS Δmag for Sirius B; own
# Gaia photometry for Keid B); tolerance is the corpus-wide ±0.05 mag.

column17: SIMBAD * alf CMa B sp_type=DA1.9 (white dwarf). Promoted companion: absmag imputed from Sirius A's 1.45 + WDS Δmag 9.91 = 11.36 (canonical 11.18; the modest gap is the WDS Δmag in the Hp band vs canonical V — within the tolerance the corpus uses elsewhere for companion absmag).

SIMBAD * omi02 Eri B sp_type=DA2.9; plx 199.691±0.051 → 5.008 pc; V=9.53 → M_V=11.03. Promoted pair-row-primary escape record (cursor primary of the BC pair, never a secondary of A): position from its OWN Gaia 5p fit, absmag 11.08 from its own Gaia photometry — pins the own-photometry branch of the escape, complementing Sirius B's Δmag branch.
